Overview

Foz do Iguaçu is a city in PR with a population of 258,823. Home to the world-famous Iguaçu Falls, one of the New Seven Wonders of Nature, and a tri-border hub with Argentina and Paraguay. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
